items.html: (And it seems to me that this is what was stated above concerning the Daat, that it is only recognizable in an inclusive manner and is entirely Gevurot. And the matter is that the Gevurot within it, being drawn from the Bina that was repaired, were revealed — unlike the Hassadim, because they are drawn from the Mochin of Hochma, which was not entirely repaired. From the Ari, of blessed memory.)
